intro.label: Introduction
intro.body: Life Design means treating your own life as a design problem to solve, using Design Thinking to work out a way of living that actually fits you.
intro.highlight: If you don't design your own life, <hl>you're left accepting whatever standardized life template society hands you</hl>, living a mass-produced, canned version of life. But everyone is a unique individual, and forcing a one-size-fits-all template never quite fits. So I drew on multiple books, synthesized different frameworks, and built <hl>a life design process of my own</hl> that has already helped many people find direction, take the wheel, and start living a life they actually love!
features: A life design process of your own
Start living a life you love

about.quote: If you don't design your own life, you're left accepting whatever standardized life template society hands you — living a canned life.
about.paragraph1: Hi, I'm Min. I used to feel lost and drained chasing the standard answers society hands you. It wasn't until I brought systems-engineering logic and an experimental mindset into my own life, breaking it down and redesigning it, that I realized I could live in a lot of different ways.
about.paragraph2: Life Design Lab didn't just pull me out of that rut — over the past two years it's also helped many participants write a new chapter for their lives. That's why I want to share it more widely, so we can all live out a life story that's truly our own.

one-on-one.title: 1:1 Coaching
one-on-one.subtitle: Life Design Lab • Deep 1:1 conversation
one-on-one.introText: Compared to the workshop or lecture formats, 1:1 coaching asks more of you upfront, but it pays off. Most clients leave with a clear direction and a full action plan that genuinely changes the course of their life.
one-on-one.extraNotice: You'll actively use the tools we cover to observe yourself between sessions, across 3-4 interviews. By the end you'll have a personal life action plan, plus one free follow-up adjustment session.

workshop.title: Workshop
workshop.subtitle: Life Design Lab • Group brainstorming
workshop.introText: Workshops run with about 3-6 people, bring your own group or join an open cohort. Focus, clarify, and build your action plan, all in one day. Sharing with other participants opens up directions you wouldn't reach alone. The full workshop runs about 8 hours, and you'll leave with your own life action plan.

structureData.content: Before the workshop, use a worksheet to start observing and clarifying yourself
Icebreakers to get comfortable with the group, so later sharing goes deeper
Observe yourself and uncover the life you actually want
Dig into your abilities and list out every possible life role
Weigh reality against what you love to build an action plan
Plan your next step and walk away with the button to start your new life

deliverables: Life-design teammates who plan alongside you and keep you accountable
A complete action plan for your personal life blueprint

small-group.title: Small Group Coaching
small-group.subtitle: Life Design Lab • Focused small-group insight
small-group.introText:
Think of small-group coaching as a hybrid of 1:1 coaching and the workshop, with one free 1-hour follow-up session included for everyone. Unlike the workshop, you don't need to interact face-to-face with the group, you lose some of the open-ended brainstorming, but gain more private time to think and process. You can also add on regular 1:1 sessions for a stronger combined effect.

Each cohort runs 5-10 people, bring your own group or join an open cohort. The course itself, not counting the follow-up session, takes about 5 hours, and you'll leave with a life design worksheet you'll use for life, plus a 1:1 coaching discount.
